description: EbbMem cognitive memory lifecycle hooks: read-only recall on SessionStart, secret-redacted capture and used-memory reinforcement on Stop. Zero telemetry.

hooks.command: sh -c 'if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; else PY=python; fi; exec "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ebbmem_hook.py" session-start'
sh -c 'if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; else PY=python; fi; exec "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ebbmem_hook.py" stop'
